title: The Daily Compass｜每日罗盘
subtitle: A bilingual daily briefing for navigating global news, culture, AI, and social change.
theme: 信任、照护与技术叙事：美伊交火、全球增长、移民家庭、特殊教育、空间艺术与AI安全
introChinese: 今天的小报关键词是：trust, care, and technological narratives（信任、照护与技术叙事）。战争与通胀削弱公共信任，签证和教育制度决定谁能获得稳定生活，而AI公司内部的安全争议提醒我们：关于技术未来的故事，往往也在决定今天谁有权提出质疑。

items.title: 美伊再度交火，停火被称为“几乎失去意义”
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，在谈判停滞与特朗普进一步威胁后，美国与伊朗再次互相发动攻击。伊朗表示美方行动使停火“几乎失去意义”。当军事行动与谈判同时推进，沟通渠道、事实核查和对平民影响的评估尤其重要。
items.correspondingEnglish: The United States and Iran traded strikes after President Trump threatened Tehran over stalled talks. Iran said the US attacks had made the ceasefire practically meaningless. When military action and negotiation continue at the same time, communication, factual verification and assessment of civilian harm become especially important.

englishExpressions.example: The strikes followed a period of stalled talks.
The two sides traded fire again.
Diplomacy should reduce the risk of civilian harm.

items.title: 世界银行：全球增长降至疫情以来最低水平
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，世界银行把2026年全球增长预测下调至2.5%，并预计中东战争将推高通胀。增长放缓并不会平均影响所有人；食品、能源和借贷成本上升时，低收入家庭与财政空间有限的国家通常承受更大压力。
items.correspondingEnglish: The World Bank said global growth was slowing to its lowest level since the pandemic. Its forecast for 2026 was reduced to 2.5%, while inflation was expected to rise because of the Middle East war. Slower growth is unevenly distributed, with low-income households and fiscally constrained countries often carrying greater pressure.

englishExpressions.example: The World Bank downgraded its growth forecast.
Fiscally constrained countries have fewer policy options.
War increased inflationary pressure.

items.title: 孕妇收到“回国”信，担忧与未出生孩子和家人分离
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，苏格兰一名孕妇护理工作者在英国签证收紧后收到内政部“回国”通知，担心与丈夫、女儿及未出生孩子分离。移民政策不是抽象边境管理，它会进入怀孕、照护关系与儿童安全感，制造持续的不确定性。
items.correspondingEnglish: A pregnant care worker in Scotland feared separation from her unborn child and family after receiving Home Office letters telling her to leave the UK. The visa clampdown left her stressed and uncertain about her husband and daughter. Immigration policy reaches into pregnancy, care relationships and children’s sense of security.

englishExpressions.example: The family was affected by a visa clampdown.
The policy created a risk of family separation.
She works in Scotland as a care worker.

items.title: 英格兰超过五分之一学生有特殊教育需求
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，英格兰超过五分之一学生被认定有特殊教育需求，接受额外支持的儿童人数大幅增加，学校、家庭与地方政府承受更大压力。需求增加不必然意味着儿童“问题更多”，也可能反映识别改善；关键在于资源是否同步增长。
items.correspondingEnglish: More than one in five pupils in England now have special educational needs. The number of children receiving additional support has risen sharply, increasing pressure on schools, families and councils. Higher recorded need may reflect better recognition, but recognition matters only when resources grow with it.

englishExpressions.example: More pupils are receiving support for special educational needs.
Schools need funding to provide additional support.
Rising numbers may partly reflect better recognition.

sections.heading: 艺术、时尚与媒体 / Art, Fashion & Media

items.title: Barbara Hepworth：色彩如何进入雕塑的身体
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 评论伦敦 Courtauld 的 Hepworth色彩展，指出她以琴弦般的线条和蓝色创造康沃尔海浪感。展览挑战“现代雕塑天然是单色”的想象，提醒观众材料、颜色与空间从来共同构成观看经验。
items.correspondingEnglish: A Courtauld exhibition examines Barbara Hepworth’s use of color. Her elegant sculptures, harp-like strings and areas of blue evoke the breakers of St Ives. The show challenges the assumption that modern sculpture is naturally monochrome and shows how material, color and space work together.

englishExpressions.example: The exhibition challenges the idea of monochrome sculpture.
Color changes the viewer’s spatial experience.
Blue surfaces evoke the sea.

items.title: Bettina：一个房间如何容纳数十年的艺术宇宙
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，隐居艺术家 Bettina 数十年在纽约Chelsea Hotel房间里填满作品，甚至睡在走廊躺椅上。部分作品首次在格拉斯哥展出。她的房间模糊了工作室、住宅与装置的边界，也让保存问题变得格外复杂。
items.correspondingEnglish: The reclusive artist Bettina spent decades filling every surface of her Chelsea Hotel room with artworks, eventually sleeping on a lawn chair in the hallway. Some works are now being displayed in Glasgow for the first time. Her room blurred the boundaries between home, studio and installation.

englishExpressions.example: Bettina was known as a reclusive artist.

englishExpressions.meaningChinese: 与特定地点紧密相连的档案
englishExpressions.example: The apartment became a site-specific archive.
The room blurred the boundary between art and life.

sections.heading: 人工智能与科技 / AI & Tech

items.title: xAI工程师称因提出Grok安全担忧而遭解雇
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，前xAI工程师 Devin Kim 起诉公司，称自己因试图为Grok聊天机器人加入安全机制而被非法解雇。内部安全人员能否提出异议，是AI治理的基础；如果纠错会带来职业惩罚，公开承诺就很难转化为真实保护。
items.correspondingEnglish: Former xAI engineer Devin Kim alleged that he was illegally fired after trying to implement safety mechanisms for the Grok chatbot. The ability of internal experts to raise concerns is foundational to AI governance. If correction carries professional punishment, public safety commitments are difficult to trust.

englishExpressions.example: The engineer tried to implement safety mechanisms.
Employees should be able to raise safety concerns.
AI companies need credible whistleblower protection.

items.title: “AI绝对主义”正在破坏我们理解未来的方式
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 评论指出，AI讨论常被两种绝对叙事占据：技术必然毁灭世界，或必然释放无限生产力。两种说法都把仍可选择的政策、商业模式和社会规范伪装成不可避免的未来。更成熟的技术讨论需要保留不确定性与集体行动空间。
items.correspondingEnglish: A Guardian analysis argues that AI debate is dominated by two absolutist stories: inevitable apocalypse or boundless productivity. Both narratives can make policy choices, business models and social norms appear unavoidable. A more mature discussion must preserve uncertainty and the possibility of collective action.

englishExpressions.example: AI absolutism reduces a complex debate to two extremes.
Technology does not create one inevitable future.
Collective action can shape how technology develops.

englishParagraph.english: Trust weakens when institutions describe choices as inevitable. War is not beyond legal judgment. Immigration rules are not separate from family life. Special educational needs require resources, not only recognition. Art shows how color and space can overturn familiar assumptions. AI companies also make choices about safety, employment and public narratives. When those choices are hidden behind claims of necessity or technological destiny, accountability becomes harder. Public trust grows when people can question decisions without being ignored, separated or punished.
englishParagraph.chinese: 当机构把选择描述成不可避免时，信任就会削弱。战争并非不受法律判断，移民规则也无法与家庭生活分开；特殊教育需求需要资源，而不只是识别。艺术展示色彩与空间如何推翻熟悉假设，AI公司同样在安全、雇佣与公共叙事上作出选择。当这些选择被“必要性”或“技术命运”遮蔽时，问责会更加困难。只有人们能够提出质疑而不被忽略、分离或惩罚，公共信任才会增长。

keywords.example: Transparent decisions can strengthen public trust.
Visa policy can create a risk of family separation.
Schools need resources for special educational needs.

keywords.meaning: AI绝对主义；把AI未来描述为唯一必然结果
keywords.example: AI absolutism hides political and social choices.

sentenceLab.sentence: Public trust grows when people can question decisions without being ignored, separated or punished.
sentenceLab.analysisChinese: when 引导条件从句；without being 后接三个并列过去分词 ignored、separated、punished，强调提出质疑所需的制度安全。

reflection.english: A future remains democratic only when people retain the right to question how it is being built.
reflection.chinese: 今天最想留下的一句话是：只有当人们仍保有追问未来如何被建造的权利，未来才可能保持民主。
